name: Bioluminescent Systems
description: Four mathematical pattern engines — Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, Fitzhugh-Nagumo excitable media, fluid advection-diffusion, and Kuramoto phase synchronization — generating the visual language of bioluminescence: glowing coral lattices, traveling pulse rings, light in moving water, and synchronized flash storms.

file_roles.repo_seed.txt: primary deep context — all equations, parameters, aesthetics, 8 generation prompts; read this first
file_roles.README.md: overview, architecture diagram, math exposition, and rendering technique descriptions
file_roles.bioluminescent_systems.js: complete runnable JS5 sketch — primary implementation reference; single-file, runs directly in RepoScripter2 sandbox
file_roles.shaders/gs_update.frag: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion GLSL update pass — 5-point Laplacian, Δt=1, clamp u/v to [0,1], mouse injection
file_roles.shaders/fn_update.frag: Fitzhugh-Nagumo excitable media GLSL update pass — stiff cubic nonlinearity, Δt≤0.01, v/w/age/emission channels
file_roles.shaders/kuramoto_update.frag: Kuramoto phase-field GLSL update pass — omega unpacked from g channel, sin-diff Laplacian, mod phase wrap, cos²(θ/2) emission
file_roles.shaders/advection.frag: Advection-diffusion GLSL update pass — curl-noise velocity (2-octave stream function), upwind advection, GS v-field source term
file_roles.shaders/composite.frag: Composite pass — additive blend of all four emission layers with exact palette hex color mapping
file_roles.shaders/bloom_down.frag: Dual Kawase bloom downsample pass — threshold=0.3, 4 levels
file_roles.shaders/bloom_up.frag: Dual Kawase bloom upsample pass — intensity=0.8, additive blend with previous level
file_roles.shaders/decay.frag: Temporal decay trail pass — trail×0.95 + emit×0.05
file_roles.shaders/output.frag: Final output pass — resolution-dependent UV-space chromatic aberration, Reinhard tone map, vignette 0.6, film grain 0.03
file_roles.src/GrayScott.js: GrayScott class — ping-pong FBO, init with 200-seed scatter, step(), setRegime(name), getTexture()
file_roles.src/FitzhughNagumo.js: FitzhughNagumo class — two-arc spiral seed init, step() clamps dt≤0.01, setMode(name), getTexture()
file_roles.src/KuramotoField.js: KuramotoField class — GPU readback order parameter via 32×32 downsample, setState(name), step(), getTexture()
file_roles.src/AdvectionDiffusion.js: AdvectionDiffusion class — curl-noise velocity field, GS source coupling, step(), getTexture()
file_roles.src/BioluminescentCompositor.js: BioluminescentCompositor class — owns all 4 engines, full post-processing pipeline, update(), injectAtMouse(), resetAll()

ai_hints.primary_vibe: dark ocean floor — pure bioluminescent emission against absolute black, light that is generated not reflected, patterns that are alive not decorative
ai_hints.render_target: Three.js WebGL2 with GPGPU ping-pong FBOs, fullscreen quad passes
known_variants: coral spawn — Gray-Scott F=0.037 k=0.060 hexagonal spot lattice
deep vein — Gray-Scott F=0.022 k=0.051 labyrinthine branching
mitosis — Gray-Scott F=0.028 k=0.053 self-replicating spots
void dissolution — Gray-Scott F=0.014 k=0.054 sparse drifting solitons
ring storm — Fitzhugh-Nagumo D=0.30 ε=0.020 expanding pulse rings
spiral lock — Fitzhugh-Nagumo D=0.50 ε=0.010 permanent rotating spirals
pulse cascade — Fitzhugh-Nagumo D=0.10 ε=0.040 dense rapid wavefronts
plankton drift — Advection D=0.002 curl-noise GS source term
vortex garden — Advection D=0.001 explicit vortices point-burst sources
plankton chaos — Kuramoto K=0.10 incoherent independent twinkling
bloom nucleation — Kuramoto K=0.80 sync islands forming and merging
shockwave sync — Kuramoto K=1.50 synchronization front sweeping field
global pulse — Kuramoto K=3.00 entire field flashing together
interaction_hooks: mouse disturbance — inject emission or trigger excitation at cursor position
mouse drag vortex — create explicit vortex that follows mouse in advection mode
click to seed — place Gray-Scott initialization seed at click location
scroll to adjust K — increase/decrease Kuramoto coupling in real time
spacebar toggle — switch between active simulation engines
hold shift — pause simulation, keep render output visible
post_processing: dual Kawase bloom threshold=0.3 levels=4 intensity=0.8
